scope: Bind the canonical Super Saiyan God Awoken Skill to the 2021-11-05 free update using direct official release evidence, without assigning a patch/version label.

official_source.title: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 LEGENDARY PACK 2 out today!
official_source.finding: The official release notice states that an exciting free update was released alongside Legendary Pack 2 and explicitly names the new Awoken Skill 'Super Saiyan God'.

finding.basis: Bandai Namco's dated 2021-11-05 release notice directly identifies Super Saiyan God as the new Awoken Skill in the accompanying free update. The canonical skill ID is already present in docs/data/skills.json; no ID is inferred.

canonical_action: No skills.json mutation. Add only release-provenance linkage.
version_boundary: The release date establishes content provenance only. No game version or patch number is assigned because the cited official notice does not provide one.
